quests.title: When the West Wind Arises

dialogue.t: It's Sara from Good Hunter!
The customers are getting hungry. Please be quick.
What do you think this is, kiddo, a fruit juice store?
Hmph. How rude! Especially since we're here to HELP!
Help? Oh yes, you're the Acting Grand Master's new hotshot helper, aren't you?
Uh... That's one way of putting it, but—
Great. Tell Jean I need my quarterly tax return forms then.
It's time to get Elzer onto doing the accounts again... I must say though, the tax rate on alcohol in Mondstadt is pretty steep.
Do you really need to get Jean involved with stuff like this?
And yet the Dawn Winery is somehow so very rich.
That's mostly down to Master Diluc's successful business model.
Why are the accounts with Jean? Does she do bookkeeping now too?
Acting Grand Master Jean personally goes over all the accounts.
After all, the wine industry is Mondstadt's main source of income. Jean takes great pains to make sure no detail is overlooked.
Paimon never knew that. Jean's job is even harder than it seems.
The Acting Grand Master's hard work indeed makes our lives a whole lot easier.
We're certainly very lucky, but... to put it bluntly, we just take it for granted that that's the norm now.
Wow... How do you sleep at night knowing how much pressure you put Jean under?
*sigh* When you put it like that I do feel quite ashamed... I suppose I should give her one on the house next time she's here.
Although... I doubt the Acting Grand Master even has the time to spare for that.
Sounds like a poor excuse to deny Jean a free drink...
Come on {NICKNAME}, let's <color=#00E1FFFF>go and see Jean</color>.
Jean's overworked? Yes, relatively speaking you guys have a lot more time on your hands.
Hey, you two!
Margaret! What are you doing here?
My cat's gone missing. Have you seen it?
No.
You mean... Diona?
No, not her. I imagine Diona's probably still in the tavern.
I mean little Princey. Prince was just home, now he's gone.
Did you seriously think Diona was a house cat!?
This is a bit worrying. What if Prince can't find his way home?
I would love to help, but...
But we are on our way to an urgent meeting with Jean. Sorry.
I guess we can have a look for your cat.
Naw, {NICKNAME}. You're always such a big softie. But aren't we in the middle of something?
Sara and Charles need our help urgently, too. Let's go and see Jean first.
You're on the way to see Jean? What a coincidence.
Paimon thought you were looking for a cat?
Yes, I wanted to see if Jean could help look for my cat.
Seriously? You want Jean... to help you look for your cat?
What's wrong with that?
Jean's a really nice person.
Such a solid line of reasoning...
I feel like this is a classic case of "good people finish last."
Please mention it to Jean for me. I'll treat you to a brew at Cat's Tail later.
Hey, HEY!
Ugh, unbelievable! Guess the case of Prince the missing cat is now added to the agenda for our meeting with Jean.
Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. It's a black cat you're looking for.
*cough*...
Acting Grand Master—
Oh, ahh— Master Jean?
...Master Jean?
Hey, Jean? Jeany Jean-Jean?
...Behold, the Dandelion Knight herself?
Oh! It's our Honorary Knight. Sorry, I must have been daydreaming.
How can I assist?
Actually, it's not us who need your help. It's a bunch of other people...
I see. Well, thank you for your service to the people of Mondstadt. *cough*
I have made a note of these commissions in my files and I will... make arrangements...
...accordingly.
Great.
We didn't miss out anyone's commissions, did we?
Sara's hilichurls, Charles' tax return, Margaret's cat... Seems that's everything.
We'll be on our way then, Jean— Jean?
Jean! Are you okay!?
How's Jean holding up? Is it serious?
It's just burnout from work stress. She'll be fine after a good old rest.
Thanks for bringing her here — she may have tried to keep soldiering on otherwise.
It's not a surprise though, she does have a lot to get through every day.
Poor Jean. She has always been one to push herself too hard while overlooking her own needs.
This isn't the first time something like this has happened.
She really has it tough doesn't she. Poor Jean.
Seems like you really care about Jean.
Oh, ah... You think so? I—I mean, she's the Acting Grand Master and all, we can't have her collapsing all the time now can we...
S—So y'know, it's not like this is a personal... thing, it's just out of love for— concern for... the greater good! Yes, that's it!
What's up with Barbara... Weird~
...Anyway, you're an honorary knight, aren't you {NICKNAME}?
While the Master is down, the knights should share her burden, no?
That's a very good point, but... Shouldn't one of the fully-qualified knights do that?
Jean has so much to do, an extra pair of hands can't hurt.
You should go and check in at the <color=#00E1FFFF>headquarters</color>. Jean will be fine with just me here.
Paimon feels like she's trying to get rid of us...
Hmm?
Nothing! We'll leave you to it — come on {NICKNAME}, let's go.
I already told you, I can take care of Jean on my own. Please help Jean out by completing her tasks.
Oh, it's Kaeya.
I've been waiting for you.
I have been informed about Jean falling ill. On behalf of all of the Knights of Favonius, allow me to express my sincere gratitude for your assistance.
So courteous and polite. This isn't the Kaeya Paimon knows.
Haha... Well, the circumstances warrant it. This is the Acting Grand Master herself we're talking about.
Now, in addition to that thank-you message, there was one other thing...
You have a job for us?
It's like you read my mind! We have quite a connection, don't you think?
Is this the part where you give us our reward?
Hahaha. I must say I like your style.
But before we can discuss a reward, there are some things I hope you can assist the Knights with.
Things like helping to fill in for Jean?
Right. Although the commissions you reported to Jean have already been handed off to someone else...
...I am concerned that they will not be handled with due care without Jean's personal touch.
So I am hoping that you can help out where you see fit.
I will feel much more at ease knowing that the Honorary Knight is personally overseeing these cases.
You can flatter {NICKNAME} all you want, but answer me this — why don't YOU do it!?
Haha... Oh, I have far more important matters to attend to. There are so many things to... to prepare.
Hmph. Fine then. So it's <color=#00E1FFFF>Sara, Charles and Margaret's</color> stuff you want us to help with, right?
Those are the ones. I appreciate the help. See you later!

quests.description: Sara from the Good Hunter restaurant appears to have a request for the Knights of Favonius…

quests.title: Margaret's Longing

dialogue.t: ...So, yours is the cat that went missing.
Venti! Have you come to help?
Me, here to help you? Why, on the contrary, it is I who needs helping!
But Paimon just saw you talking to Margaret about Prince...
Aha! So, Prince is the name of the feline fiend who thieved my spare <color=#00E1FFFF>astral iron strings</color>!
Though it gladdens my heart to see that the free-spirited ethos of Mondstadt is alive and well in creatures great and small... Still, it's a bit audacious!
Haha, Prince is a mischievous little rascal alright!
Spoken just like a parent who chooses to spoil said rascal!
Indeed. Just like Barbatos...
Ahaha, yes, quite... quite... Ahem! Now, let's see about getting ourselves an audience with his little highness, Prince Rascal of Mondstadt!
I have a performance tonight, and without my spare strings, I shall have to disappoint my audience.
What would a kitty cat want with lyre strings anyway?
Everyone knows cats go crazy for a ball of string!
What!?
These lyre strings are made of astral iron, which contains Anemo energy. That makes them extremely durable, so I normally just roll them up in a ball to make them easier to carry.
That's a trick of the trade from a traveling bard!
The strings contain Anemo energy?
That'll help us! {NICKNAME}, it's time for you to use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> again!
...So, yours is the cat that went missing.
Venti! Have you come to help?
Me, here to help you? Why, on the contrary, it is I who needs helping!
But Paimon just saw you talking to Margaret about Prince...
Aha! So, Prince is the name of the feline fiend who thieved my spare <color=#00E1FFFF>astral iron strings</color>!
Though it gladdens my heart to see that the free-spirited ethos of Mondstadt is alive and well in creatures great and small... Still, it's a bit audacious!
Haha, Prince is a mischievous little rascal alright!
Spoken just like a parent who chooses to spoil said rascal!
Indeed. Just like Barbatos...
Ahaha, yes, quite... quite... Ahem! Now, let's see about getting ourselves an audience with his little highness, Prince Rascal of Mondstadt!
I have a performance tonight, and without my spare strings, I shall have to disappoint my audience.
What would a kitty cat want with lyre strings anyway?
Everyone knows cats go crazy for a ball of string!
What!?
These lyre strings are made of astral iron, which contains Anemo energy. That makes them extremely durable, so I normally just roll them up in a ball to make them easier to carry.
That's a trick of the trade from a traveling bard!
The strings contain Anemo energy?
That'll help us! {NICKNAME}, it's time for you to use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> again!
Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. Remember, he's got black fur.
Where have you been looking?
Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. Remember, he's got black fur.
Meow!
Wow, Prince has very keen senses. It didn't take much to scare him off.
See if you can approach him crouching <color=#00E1FFFF>from behind</color>. That way, your footsteps will be quieter.
It must be difficult not being able to float, hee-hee.
If you're anxious to find Prince, why not coax him to you with some <color=#00E1FFFF>Fish</color>? Kitty cats do love eating fish.
If you've run out of <color=#00E1FFFF>Fish</color>, go grab some more from the lake. Now, back to it!
Drat! He's run off again.
But where is he going? Hmm, Paimon wonders if...
Prince! Good boy, that's my Prince, I knew you'd come home to me...
Prince! Where did you go running off to? Thank goodness you're safe...
He made sure we had our work cut out for us looking for him.
Oh Princey, how could you leave me like that...
Looks like those two need some time to themselves...
And here are your astral iron strings, Venti.
You found them! Wonderful! I was not optimistic they would turn up.
I daresay that a private performance played using these very same strings would not be an excessive way to show my gratitude! ...Ah, ah...
Ah what?
ACHOO!
*cough* Haha... Apologies. At this distance, my cat allergy seems to be rearing its head...
Oh, now Paimon gets why you didn't go looking for your strings by yourself...
Hehe, anyway, thanks for the help, I'll be going now— a—achoo!

quests.description: While Jean is ill from overwork, you’ve been tasked with handling some citizens’ commissions on her behalf. Where has Margaret’s pet cat Prince run off to this time?

quests.title: Charles' Troubles

dialogue.t: Lisa? Are you here about the tax return?
Oh, hello darling. You're quite right. After I heard about poor Jean, I thought I might lend a hand with some of her more literary duties.
Cool, well if we're no longer needed here, we'll be on our way.
Oh wait a moment... Actually, Charles here was wondering—
Please, allow me, ma'am.
I just took a rather important order, but unfortunately we've run completely dry and the delivery from the winery is behind schedule.
If it's not too much trouble, could you go and <color=#00E1FFFF>do something about this logistical nuisance</color>?
What's so urgent about this order?
*sigh* It came in at the last minute. Literally, just a few seconds ago.
Exactly, hence the urgency.
Okay, I'll see what I can do.
Okay, but my next drink here had better be on the house!
Heh... I'm positive that next time my boss Master Diluc is here, he'll pick up the tab for you.
Sounds about right!
It's not uncommon for delivery workers to take a couple of bottles for themselves and make a bit of extra cash on the side. But obviously you don't seem like the type.
So this is where Charles' delivery got to.
Have you come to rescue me? I've been waiting long enough.
In all the time I've been working at the winery, this is the first time I've been robbed by hilichurls. *sigh*
If you'd taken any longer, I don't know what I would have done.
Fear not. {NICKNAME} here is a hilichurl exterminator extraordinaire!
Just as well. Then... please escort this <color=#00E1FFFF>transporter</color> to the end of the road.

And be careful with it. Just beating up the hilichurls is the not the aim here. You'd better <color=#00E1FFFF>make sure the goods stay intact</color> because I certainly don't have the Mora to replace them.
I'll be waiting up ahead.
Thank you, my friend. I thought I was in deep trouble this time. It's a good thing you showed up.
I'll put in a good word for you with the gentlemen at the winery.

quests.description: Has Charles managed to get hold of the tax forms he needs?

quests.title: Sara's Worries

dialogue.t: Got it. I'll set off right away!
Amber! Are you here to help out with Jean's commission?
Oh, hi. Yeah, I was just getting ready. Who better than an Outrider to mop up some hilichurls on the delivery route?
*sigh* ...
Sara... What are you still stressing about? I'm an Outrider, and I won't disappoint!
You misunderstand me. I don't doubt your abilities, I'm just overwhelmed at the number of orders piling up in front of me.
Another bizarre order came in just now. It's like they're hosting a banquet or something...
*clears throat*...
Is there anything we can help with?
I can help with the cooking!
Really! You don't mind helping?
That would be wonderful! You really are the Good Hunter's guardian angel.
Yeah well... Those hilichurls are going to be a handful, too.
Well, why don't you take this order. Start by getting the ingredients.
Are you sure {NICKNAME} can be trusted? It might end up tasting a bit funky...
We're well past the point of aiming for perfection. This is now a fight to save the Good Hunter's business.
A fight?
For this dish, we need... <color=#00E1FFFF>three Sweet Flowers and three Fowls</color>.
Okay, go and get ready. You too, Amber. I'll be waiting here.
O—Okay...
Have you brought me <color=#00E1FFFF>three Sweet Flowers and three Fowls</color>? Let me see...
Can I get food to-go?
Certainly. Here's the menu.
I'm still not ready...
I see. Let's not keep the customers waiting too long.
<color=#00E1FFFF>Three sweet flowers and three fowls</color>, please. Thanks.
You're back — have you brought the ingredients? Let me see...
...Yep. That's everything.
Now — order number seven is for one <color=#00E1FFFF>Sweet Madame</color>.
And so begins the story of us becoming basic kitchen hands!
You did say you'd help Good Hunter out — be sure to serve it while it's hot.
Any news on that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sweet Madame</color>?
Can I get food to-go?
Certainly. Here's the menu.
I'm still not ready...
I see. Let's not keep the customers waiting too long.
Where's that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sweet Madame</color> up to? Hurry, we have service standards to maintain...
One Sweet Madame, received!
Mmm, it smells... pretty good! You have a knack for this — just the person I need!
Hmm, since you cook so well... You might as well take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color> next.
<color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>! We tried that before, with Amber!
That's right, a mainstay of the Good Hunter menu. It's my pride and joy!
The Knights order it almost every time they come here for a gathering.
Let me teach you the recipe for a <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>...
Wait, didn't you say it's your pride and joy? You're going to teach us how to make it, just like that?
With your cooking skills, I don't think you will be doing a disservice to the Good Hunter brand! Hee-hee.
As soon as that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color> is ready, please bring it here.
One Sweet Madame, received!
Mmm! That smells absolutely divine! This is nothing less than what I would expect from a head chef, never mind a sous-chef...
Hmm, since you cook so well... You might as well take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color> next.
<color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>? Paimon's sure she's heard Amber and Kaeya mention this one before.
That's right, a mainstay of the Good Hunter menu. It's my pride and joy!
The Knights order it almost every time they come here for a gathering.
Let me teach you the recipe for a <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>...
Wait, didn't you say it's your pride and joy? You're going to teach us how to make it, just like that?
With your cooking skills, I don't think you will be doing a disservice to the Good Hunter brand! Hee-hee.
As soon as that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color> is ready, please bring it here.
I'm still waiting on one <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>. Have you got it?
Can I get food to-go?
Certainly. Here's the menu.
I'm still not ready...
I see. Let's not keep the customers waiting too long.
One <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>, please. I thought I taught you the recipe already?
Is it ready? Let me see, let me seeee!
This is a very good effort. I think you really captured the essence of what the dish is all about.
Are we released from kitchen duty now?
Yes, thanks ever so much for your help. Amber should be able to take care of everything else.
If you ever get tired of being an adventurer, there'll be a job waiting for you at Good Hunter if you want it!
Is it ready? Let me see, let me seeee!
This is... Wow. Did you really cook this? This is quite simply astonishing. You were born to be a head chef!
Are we released from kitchen duty now?
Yes, thanks ever so much for your help. Amber should be able to take care of everything else.
If you ever get tired of being an adventurer, there'll be a job waiting for you at Good Hunter if you want it!

quests.description: Sara’s delivery of ingredients still hasn’t arrived, and she’s growing more anxious by the minute…

quests.title: Master's Day Off

dialogue.t: Hi Barbara, we're back.
Welcome back. You must be exhausted.
How is Jean doing?
I'm sure you must be exhausted, too.
Oh it's nothing, looking after patients is all in a day's work for me.
Jean has regained consciousness and should be back to her normal self soon enough.
That's great news! Let's go and see her.
But she just left the Cathedral. I tried to tell her she needs more rest, but she wouldn't listen.
She tried to act like she was fine and kept saying she wanted to get some fresh air. I bet you she's gone to <color=#00E1FFFF>Lady Vennessa's place</color> again.
Where?
Oh, that <color=#00E1FFFF>huge tree at Windrise</color>. That place is dedicated to Mondstadt's hero, Vennessa.
Jean goes there whenever she feels lost and confused deep down inside.
Barbara, that's some pretty personal stuff... How do you know so much about Jean's innermost thoughts?
...Jean, uh, mentioned it to me, y'know, before she left.
Jean is still recovering, right?
Will she be okay out there on her own, in her condition?
That's what I'm worried about, too. But I still have work to do here...
Don't worry, we'll take over nursing duty for now.
Great! That puts my mind at rest. May the Anemo Archon protect you... and Jean.
Jean is not as strong as she comes off. It's so good that you're here for her.
Hi Jean, are you feeling better now?
Much better. I was not expecting you to come here. Thank you for your concern.
Are you sure? We saw you beneath the tree just now, leaning on your sword — it looked like you were struggling.
Are you sure you aren't pushing yourself too hard?
You can always rely on the other knights.
You can always rely on us.
Oh... Thank you, that means a lot to me. Hearing that boosts my spirits.
But I must find a way to cope with minor setbacks like this on my own. Otherwise, how can I be the protector that Mondstadt needs me to be? The protector that Vennessa was...
You truly revere Vennessa, huh?
I do. Vennessa was the first Grand Master, a kind yet formidable woman. I have always hoped to follow in her footsteps.

As the Lionfang Knight, she courageously overthrew the oppressive ruling aristocracy of her time. Then, she founded the Knights of Favonius and became known as the Dandelion Knight, spreading grace and compassion throughout the land.
Dandelion Knight — isn't that your title?
Hmm... Actually, all of the Knights of Favonius' Masters throughout the ages have inherited the title of "Dandelion Knight" or "Lionfang Knight."
Oooh, that makes sense now.
You too want to be as gentle as the Dandelion Knight and yet as fierce as the Lionfang Knight?
Yes. I know it sounds like a huge honor, inheriting both these titles from Vennessa...
But I see it more as a huge responsibility.
After all, it is a lot to live up to.
I could get used to Jean the Lionfang Knight...
Actually, Dandelion Knight suits you better.
Paimon thinks so too!
Jean?
Who's there?
Are you hurt!?
Ugh, darn him and his traps!
How badly are you hurt? One of my own being injured because of me is the last thing I would wish for.
...Let me handle this alone.
No! You're in no state to handle this alone. We're coming, too!
...Okay. But before we move out, at least let me heal everyone with my <color=#00E1FFFF>Dandelion Breeze</color>.
Thanks, you're amazing!
Phew... Thanks to Barbara's help, my condition is better than I thought.
The main thing is that you're safe. Now, isn't it time to get <color=#00E1FFFF>back to Mondstadt</color> and rest, Acting Grand Master?
Yes. I should at least go and thank Barbara again. I hope she is not upset with me.
Master, you've finally returned! The Anemo Archon protects you.
Swan? Were you waiting for me? Has something happened?
Yes... At the <color=#00E1FFFF>Angel's Share</color>. Don't worry, it's nothing big, but...
Has there been a bar fight?
We'll go. Jean needs to rest.
Ah... I know I said it's nothing big, but... Alright, how can I put this... They just really need the Acting Grand Master.
Huh?
Well, if you say so Swan, I will go. I should not let the other knights down.
It's fine. Now that I have had the chance to stretch my legs, I feel much better.
Great! Thank you so much, you really saved me on this one.
For goodness' sake... What is happening to the world!? Swan used to be the most honest fellow, now he's dumping things onto Jean...
Well... Swan was clearly agitated. Maybe it is an emergency after all. Let's go and see what this is all about, shall we?
Oh? What's all this?
It's a thank-you party for you!
A thank-you party?
Jean, when we heard the news about your illness, we were all so worried about you.
We can only imagine how much pressure you must be under as Acting Grand Master, and you do so much work all over Mondstadt...
We thought that since you so rarely take any time off, we'd take this chance to throw you a party. Enjoy yourself, Jean.
After all, you'll never let us do this once you're back at work, haha.
Huh...
Jean?
Huh? Is this Jean when she's... shy? I've never seen her like this!
It's easy to forget that outside of work, Jean is just a normal person, like anyone else.
I... This is just all such a surprise!
Thank you, everyone. This really means so much to me.
Hehehe. Well, it's nothing compared to the amount of work you do for all of us, day in and day out.
But... there are so many things I still need to do...
*sigh*
Fear not. We wanted to make sure you could relax and enjoy yourself...
So while you were away, we all pitched in and finished off your work for you. Every last task.
Did you really? ...Even the issue with the food deliveries?
It was no different from what we see on patrol. A couple of hilichurls. Didn't take much to get rid of them.
And the tax returns?
I spend so much time doing library admin. A few more pieces of paper to deal with was really nothing to worry about.
Well... What about Margaret's missing cat?
...Are you kidding me?
That rascally Prince was apprehended by the brilliant Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}! And he(she) also reclaimed my precious astral iron strings while he(she) was at it.
Enough already! No more thinking about work today! Enjoy yourself while you've got the chance.
It is my honor to work alongside you all. Praise be for the Anemo Archon's guidance...
Speaking of work... It must have been hard work to put all this together. Where did you find the time?
Haha... Actually, {NICKNAME} was the key organizer behind all of this.
Me?
The organizer?
See all this food and drink? {NICKNAME} made sure it all arrived on time.
Not only that, but he(she) cooked each one of these beautiful dishes himself(herself).
So relax already. There's no need to be so modest!
Uh... This explains a lot!
All those last-minute urgent orders... It was you all along!
Of course, we also have Master Diluc to thank for the venue. Otherwise, we would be looking at quite an alarming bill right about now.
...Despite my initial reluctance to sponsor a Knights of Favonius event in any way...
I, like any other citizen of Mondstadt, owe Jean my gratitude for her hard work.
Oh, Master Diluc, I—
Alright, alright! Jean's supposed to be taking it easy. Stop crowding her!
Agreed! Now — let the party begin!
Oh, it is you.

dialogue.sit: Are you having a good time?

dialogue.t: Yes, I am just... getting some air.
Uh-oh, it seems like something's bothering Jean.
{NICKNAME}, I want to thank you again—
Actually, I knew nothing about this whole thing either.

dialogue.sit: Either way, it is good to be here together with everyone. It has lifted my spirits.
It is good to be here together with everyone. It has lifted my spirits.

dialogue.t: And it has taught me something.
What's that?
I am definitely more of a Dandelion Knight than a Lionfang Knight.
The Lionfang Knight represents Vennessa's past — a past in which she fought hard for Mondstadt.
But it was the Dandelion Knight that represented her hopes for the future — a future belonging to the newly formed Knights of Favonius...
Jean, Vennessa would be so proud of who you are right now.
I do believe that Vennessa watches over us, whether from high up above, or from the wind all around us.
Let the Wind lead.
Let the Wind lead. The winds of freedom will guide us along the path that lies ahead. I hope you will continue to join us on that path, {NICKNAME}.
It is good to be here together with everyone. It has lifted my spirits.
Are you having a good time?
Whew... This is quite a lot of excitement, considering that the idea was to relax and take it easy...
Would a drink help you relax?
Ahh... Is there anything without alcohol?
What do you normally drink?
Oh, y'know, I normally mix a few things together, but I always add some bright red—
Red? Let me guess... tomatoes? No, watermelon?
...Hehe, chilis! I add chili peppers.
Chili pepper!? In a drink?
Hey! Having a good time?
Why did you say I was the organizer?
The thing is, Jean knows all of us so well now...
When someone organizes a surprise party for you, the closer you are to them, the more bashful you tend to feel about the whole thing.
So instead, we just gave you all the credit. After all, you did do more than your fair share of the work anyway.
So... You gave me the credit to hide your own shyness?
Of course! This party was clearly Kaeya's idea! Shy Kaeya? This is gold!
Haha... You think so?
So you admit it!
Hehe... I'm only indulging you since it's such a special day today.
My word, the Dawn Winery's wine is every bit as delectable as they say!
I would never be able to afford this normally, so in the spirit of enjoying the moment while it lasts... Another glass for the bard, please!
Venti can drink a frightening amount...
Ah, hello! I didn't see you there.
I blame the wine for monopolizing my attention! Much like my ballads, it deserves to be enjoyed for generations to come.
What is this floating sensation I feel? Have I discovered the true meaning of Anemo power?
That would be the drink talking...
I hereby declare that every son and daughter of the City of the Wind must be compelled to taste this finest of wines... Here's to good wine!
That's glass number thirty-seven.
What's Diluc doing?
I am keeping count of this bard's alarming pace of progress through my wine.
Only the Knights drink for free tonight. It seems he didn't get the message.
When he sobers up, I will present him with the bill.
Diluc... You're a meanie!
...I'm joking, of course. I highly doubt he could afford it anyway, so I shall spare him the bill.
But I must say, the sheer volume of alcohol this fellow can put back is just not normal.
"Leaving the hustle and bustle of the banquet behind them, the two of them stood there, together in the quiet of the night, while the rest of the world melted away around them..."
Sounds like the sort of thing you'd find in a romantic novel, no?
I'm not trying to get you to recite poetry to me or anything...
I'm just saying, <color=#00E1FFFF>Jean went upstairs to the balcony. Alone.</color> Now's your chance... Hehe.
{NICKNAME}...
Amber! You look like you're about to burst into tears. Whatever is the matter?
Two things! One, this Sweet Madame! Two, this Sticky Honey Roast!
Did you make them?
You'd better believe it!
Mmm... I refuse to believe it! Where did you suddenly learn to cook so well?
I'm going to finish eating this, and then you're going to teach me everything you know! Don't you dare try and run off!
*om nom nom*
Has... Amber been drinking?
